entries.title: Crewmates can clear a GitLab merge request in a project with no hosted checks
entries.body: A crewmate's merge request from a branch in the same GitLab project was refused as if it came from someone else's copy of the project. Now the crewmate can review it, and in a project with no hosted checks it can record that the project's own checks passed, so you can merge it. Merge requests from other copies of the project are still refused.
entries.noPicture: This changes what a crewmate may record for a GitLab merge request, not a view or control.
